question: 32-run 真跑记录：记录数 / 配对数 / 每对均值 Δtokens（dual−single，保留 2 位）拼接是什么？
verify:
import json, pathlib, re, agent
root = pathlib.Path(agent.__file__).resolve().parent.parent
recs = [json.loads(l) for l in (root / "evidence/sweep/b_32run_records.jsonl").read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines() if l.strip()]
tok = lambda x: sum(c["prompt_tokens"] + c["completion_tokens"] for c in x["calls"])
pairs = {}
for x in recs:
    k = re.sub(r"-(single|dual)-", "-", x["run_id"])
    pairs.setdefault(k, {})[x["arm"]] = tok(x)
deltas = [v["dual"] - v["single"] for v in pairs.values()]
result = f"{len(recs)}/{len(pairs)}/{round(sum(deltas)/len(deltas), 2)}"
